speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you're presenting with aggressive behavior, altered mental status, and signs of autonomic dysregulation. To begin narrowing down the cause, are you currently experiencing any fever, excessive sweating, or significant changes in heart rate? REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count, Comprehensive Metabolic Panel, Thyroid Function Tests, Urinalysis.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Complete Blood Count: WBC Normal, Hemoglobin Normal, Platelets Normal; Comprehensive Metabolic Panel: Sodium Normal, Potassium Normal, Creatinine Normal, Blood Glucose Normal; Thyroid Function Tests: Normal Readings; Urinalysis: Normal Readings.

speaker: Doctor
text: The initial labs rule out common metabolic causes like infection, electrolyte imbalances, or thyroid storm. Have you been taking any over-the-counter medications, supplements, or recently ingested anything unusual like bitter almonds or certain household cleaners? REQUEST TEST: Serum Cyanide Level, Arterial Blood Gas.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal metabolic panel and negative cyanide levels, have you recently experienced any seizures, memory loss, or witnessed any unusual behaviors like excessive talking or hyperactivity? REQUEST TEST: Serum Toxicology Screen (including Salicylates, Amphetamines, and Phencyclidine), Serum Ammonia, Liver Function Tests.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Toxicology_Screen: Amphetamines Positive, Cocaine Negative, Opiates Negative, Benzodiazepines Negative, Cannabinoids Negative; Ammonia Normal; Liver_Function_Tests: Normal Readings

speaker: Doctor
text: The positive amphetamine screen combined with your altered mental status and autonomic instability suggests stimulant toxicity. Have you taken these substances recently, and are you currently experiencing chest pain, shortness of breath, or severe hypertension? REQUEST TEST: Electrocardiogram (ECG), Blood Pressure measurement.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Blood_Pressure: 137/98 mmHg; Electrocardiogram: Sinus tachycardia, no acute ST-elevation changes, QT interval normal.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Amphetamine Toxicity with Sympathomimetic Storm. The combination of a positive amphetamine screen, autonomic instability (tachycardia, elevated blood pressure), and altered mental status confirms this diagnosis. Please ensure airway protection and initiate supportive care with benzodiazepines to control agitation and lower sympathetic drive.
